items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I'm trying to think who was he playing with. Oh, he was playing with Clark Terry's band.

ctx.x: I knew her then and I saw her last summer in New York.
You did? Gosh, I'd love to see her. She sang with Clark Terry's
(inaudible) band (inaudible) at a concert at the New School.
